scope: Read-only audit of previously passed final Cloudflare33 fixture. No product edits or rerun.

predicateMechanism.helper: until(f): for up to300 polls, evaluate synchronous f(); return only when truthy; otherwise await25ms delay. All call sites return DOM comparisons, boolean diagnostics fields, or !!qa.releaseSpin.
predicateMechanism.diagnostics: controller module import is awaited once; exported diagnostics() returns a plain synchronous object. No poll callback returns an import Promise.
predicateMechanism.connectorCompletion: Browser Rendering waits for DOM selector #qa-result. Scenario creates that pre only after all awaited assertions/1800ms no-next-wager observations, or creates an explicit error result in catch. This uses waitForSelector, not Playwright waitForFunction.

requesting: AUTO10 remains active while request is held
active AUTO stop remains enabled with saved pending token
requesting AUTO stop immediately clears repeat mode
cancelling requesting AUTO adds no debit or POST
animating: active AUTO stop remains enabled during animation
animating AUTO stop clears repeat mode
cancelling animating AUTO adds no debit or POST
pendingRecovery: lost receipt ends AUTO without another wager
inactive AUTO is locked until saved receipt resolves
AUTO receipt retry uses identical saved payload
AUTO receipt retry never adds another debit
AUTO receipt retry settles only original round
confirmed AUTO recovery does not restart repeat mode

savedTokenEvidence.mechanism: The isolated fixture holds fetch resolution only after WalletAdapter.spin creates/stores pending request. Frozen bundled WalletAdapter stores pending in sessionStorage before invoking spin HTTP request. During held phase the scenario explicitly requires body=requesting,autoRemaining10,enabledAUTO,STOP10; then cancels without anotherPOST/debit. Lost-response case explicitly compares complete serialized request payloads, which include roundToken.
savedTokenEvidence.limitation: No separate direct sessionStorage value assertion was counted; do not describe one as executed.

conclusion: The async-predicate Playwright defect does not affect this final CF33 evidence. Every poll predicate is synchronous and explicit subsequent checks prove the observed requesting/animating/pending states and exact settlement counts. No validity concern requiring rerun.
